3143-sir-walter-raleigh-and-his-time.title: Sir Walter Raleigh And His Time
3143-sir-walter-raleigh-and-his-time.creator: Unknown
3143-sir-walter-raleigh-and-his-time.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. They were men, certainly, very much of our own level: but may we not put that level somewhat too low? They were certainly not what we are; for if they had been, they would have done no more than we: but is not a man’s real level not what he is, but what he can be, and therefore ought to be?

38916-the-trial-of-oscar-wilde-from-the-.title: The Trial Of Oscar Wilde From The Shorthand Reports
38916-the-trial-of-oscar-wilde-from-the-.creator: Unknown
38916-the-trial-of-oscar-wilde-from-the-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The true debauchee has no such object. He seeks only for pleasure and discounts beforehand the conditions that Life dictates for the same; the conditions laid down containing no guarantee that the pleasure will be actually grasped except only in promise and anticipation. Later, too proud to acknowledge his cruel disappointment, he will gravely assure us that the bitterness left in the bottom of the goblet whose wine he has quaffed, has indeed the sweet taste that he sought after.

arxiv-1911-07898.title: Large Scale Dynamo in a Primordial Accretion Flow – An Interpretation from Hydrodynamic Simulation
arxiv-1911-07898.creator: Wei-Ting Liao, Matthew Turk, Hsi-Yu Schive
arxiv-1911-07898.description: Abstract Without an existing large scale coherent magnetic field in the early Universe, Population III (PopIII) stars would likely rotate at or near break-up speed. In this work, focusing on the accretion phase of PopIII stars, we investigate the possibility of generating a coherent magnetic field through large scale dynamo processes, as well as the corresponding field saturation level.

arxiv-2007-05439.creator: G.MURUGUSUNDARAMOORTHY 1 and Saurabh Porwal 2 , ∗ {}^{2,\;\ast}
arxiv-2007-05439.description: Abstract . The purpose of the present paper is to establish connections between various subclasses of analytic univalent functions by applying certain convolution operator involving Touchard polynomials. To be more precise, we investigate such connections with the classes of analytic univalent functions with positive coefficients in the open unit disk 𝕌 . \mathbb{U}. 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification: 30C45.

arxiv-2102-02971.title: Metaknowledge Extraction Based on Multi-Modal Documents
arxiv-2102-02971.creator: Shukan Liu, Ruilin Xu, Boying Geng, Qiao Sun, Li Duan, Yiming Liu
arxiv-2102-02971.description: Abstract The triple-based knowledge in large-scale knowledge bases is most likely lacking in structural logic and problematic of conducting knowledge hierarchy. In this paper, we introduce the concept of metaknowledge to knowledge engineering research for the purpose of structural knowledge construction.

arxiv-2107-02570.title: Practical I/O-Efficient Multiway Separators
arxiv-2107-02570.creator: Svend C. Svendsen
arxiv-2107-02570.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Svend C. Svendsen. We revisit the fundamental problem of I/O-efficiently computing r r -way separators on planar graphs. An r r -way separator divides a planar graph with N N vertices into O ⁡ ( r ) O(r) regions of size O ⁡ ( N / r ) O(N/r) and O ⁡ ( N ​ r ) O(\sqrt{Nr}) boundary vertices in total, where boundary vertices are vertices that are adjacent to more than one region.

arxiv-2203-06573.title: Homogeneity and Sub-homogeneity Pursuit: Iterative Complement Clustering PCA Thanks: Corresponding author, email: le.chang@anu.edu.au
arxiv-2203-06573.description: Abstract Principal component analysis (PCA), the most popular dimension-reduction technique, has been used to analyze high-dimensional data in many areas. It discovers the homogeneity within the data and creates a reduced feature space to capture as much information as possible from the original data.

arxiv-2301-11394.title: Customer Momentum
arxiv-2301-11394.creator: Mykola Pinchuk
arxiv-2301-11394.description: Abstract \usdate ABSTRACT This paper examines customer momentum, defined as a positive relationship between a firm’s returns and past returns of its customers. I confirm previous evidence (Cohen and Frazzini 2008) that customer momentum is both statistically and economically significant. Long-short equally-weighted (value-weighted) decile portfolio generates a monthly return of 122 (106) basis points and a t-statistic above 4 (2.

arxiv-2305-13851.title: Correlating New Physics Effects in Semileptonic Δ ​ C = 1 \Delta C=1 and Δ ​ S = 1 \Delta S=1 Processes
arxiv-2305-13851.creator: Svjetlana Fajfer, Jernej F. Kamenik, Arman Korajac, Nejc Košnik
arxiv-2305-13851.description: Abstract We present constraints on the left-handed dimension-6 interactions that contribute to semileptonic and leptonic decays of K K , D D , pions and to nuclear beta decay. We employ the flavour covariant description of the effective couplings, identify universal CP phases of New Physics and derive constraints from decay rates and CP-odd quantities.

As KGs are widespread across multiple domains and contain important entity-relation information, and as text simplification aims to reduce the complexity of a text while preserving the meaning of the original text, we propose KGSimple , a novel approach to unsupervised text simplification which infuses KG-established techniques in order to construct a simplified KG

arxiv-2310-05797.title: In-Context Explainers: Harnessing LLMs for Explaining Black Box Models
arxiv-2310-05797.creator: Nicholas Kroeger*, Dan Ley*, Satyapriya Krishna, Chirag Agarwal, Himabindu Lakkaraju
arxiv-2310-05797.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nicholas Kroeger*, Dan Ley*, Satyapriya Krishna, Chirag Agarwal, Himabindu Lakkaraju. Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in complex tasks like machine translation, commonsense reasoning, and language understanding. One of the primary reasons for the adaptability of LLMs in such diverse tasks is their in-context learning (ICL) capability, which allows them to perform well on new tasks by simply using a few task samples in the prompt.

arxiv-2311-01507.title: Gravity-Matter Sum Rules in models with a single extra-dimension
arxiv-2311-01507.creator: A. de Giorgi, S. Vogl
arxiv-2311-01507.description: Abstract We prove a set of sum rules needed for KK-graviton pair production from matter in orbifolded extra-dimensional models. The sum rules can be found in full generality by considering the properties of solutions to the Sturm-Liouville problem, which describes the wave functions and the masses of the KK-gravitons in four dimensions.

arxiv-2402-12971.title: Differentiability in Unrolled Training of Neural Physics Simulators on Transient Dynamics
arxiv-2402-12971.creator: Bjoern List, Li-Wei Chen, Kartik Bali, Nils Thuerey
arxiv-2402-12971.description: Abstract Unrolling training trajectories over time strongly influences the inference accuracy of neural network-augmented physics simulators. We analyze this in three variants of training neural time-steppers. In addition to one-step setups and fully differentiable unrolling, we include a third, less widely used variant: unrolling without temporal gradients.

arxiv-2408-09955.title: MegaAgent: A Large-Scale Autonomous LLM-based Multi-Agent System Without Predefined SOPs
arxiv-2408-09955.creator: Qian Wang, Tianyu Wang, Zhenheng Tang, Qinbin Li, Nuo Chen, Jingsheng Liang, Bingsheng He
arxiv-2408-09955.description: Abstract LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown promise in tackling complex tasks. However, existing solutions often suffer from limited agent coordination and heavy reliance on predefined Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), which demand extensive human input. To address these limitations, we propose MegaAgent , a large-scale autonomous LLM-based multi-agent system.

arxiv-2410-06562.title: Boundedness of the Cherednik kernel and its limit transition from type BC to type A
arxiv-2410-06562.creator: Dominik Brennecken
arxiv-2410-06562.description: Abstract . We introduce a Cherednik kernel and a hypergeometric function for integral root systems and prove their relation to spherical functions associated with Riemannian symmetric spaces of reductive Lie groups. Furthermore, we characterize the spectral parameters for which the Cherednik kernel is a bounded function.

arxiv-2410-08999.description: Abstract Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) represents a transformative approach within 5G and beyond, aiming to merge wireless communication and sensing functionalities into a unified network infrastructure. This integration offers enhanced spectrum efficiency, real-time situational awareness, cost and energy reductions, and improved operational performance.

pmc-10654595.creator: Sergio Villa-Consuegra, Víctor A. Tallada, Juan Jimenez
pmc-10654595.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). SummaryDuring meiosis, faithful chromosome segregation requires monopolar spindle microtubule-kinetochore arrays in MI to segregate homologous chromosomes, but bipolar in MII to segregate sister chromatids. Using fission yeasts, we found that the universal Aurora B kinase localizes to kinetochores in metaphase I and in the mid-spindle during anaphase I, as in mitosis; but in the absence of an intervening S phase, the importin α Imp1 propitiates its release from the spindle midzone to re-localize at kinetochores during meiotic interkinesis.

pmc-12473952.creator: Benjamin Beluzo, Maytham Ismail, Sergei Chuikov, Venkateshwar G. Keshamouni, Mathumai Kanapathipillai
pmc-12473952.description: Background/Objectives: Lysozyme-based amyloid aggregates offer a promising platform for RNA delivery due to their stability, cationic nature, biocompatibility, and ability to form well-defined structures. pmc-12522904.title: Meconium-stained amniotic fluid and its associated factors among mothers who gave birth in Ethiopia: systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12522904.creator: Bacha Merga Chuko, Girma Teferi Mengistu, Fikru Assefa Kibrat, Abera Cheru, Shambal Negese, Nebiyu Taye
pmc-12522904.description: BackgroundMeconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) happens during childbearing when the amniotic fluid carries traces of meconium, the initial stool passed by a newborn. Often signaling fetal distress, meconium-stained amniotic fluid is linked to heightened risks for both the mother and the newborn. In Ethiopia, there is inadequate attention given to this condition.

pmc-12573872.creator: Chongmei Tian, Su Dong, Jianmiao Jin, Jinzhong Wang, Jiefang Zhou, Yaping Zhao, Jing-bai Chen
pmc-12573872.description: BackgroundEikenella corrodens mainly resides in the oral cavity as a part of the human oral microbiota. Infections caused by this organism are particularly rare. We report a case of a left-hand soft tissue infection caused by E. corrodens and Streptococcus anginosus, following the use of a toothpick.

pmc-12594354.title: Social credit scores reduce interpersonal cooperation and trust
pmc-12594354.creator: Alexander Genevsky
pmc-12594354.description: Social credit systems (SCS) are increasingly used by government agencies and private firms to assign scores to individuals based on social status and behavior. These scores subsequently impact access to social and economic opportunities, resources, and interactions. The ethical and privacy concerns of SCS are frequently overlooked due to their purported, yet unverified, social and economic benefits.

pmc-12743235.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping medical education, offering new opportunities to personalize learning, enhance research, and streamline administration.
